title: console/status/v1
description: The status frame of every browser-facing and machine-facing WebSocket, on connect and every 2 s (decision record M29, Appendix C; M12: it replaces `feed/status/v1`). It carries the display thresholds: consumers never default them (uspace-ui Q6). The optional extras are named in Appendix C and M29; a consumer renders them when present and ignores them when absent.

server_ts.description: The server's clock when the frame was sent; consumers derive their clock offset from it.

stale_after_s.description: A track older than this is shown stale. Policy; zero or negative is refused (LESSONS E-15).

live_max_age_s.description: A track younger than this is shown live. Policy; zero or negative is refused (LESSONS E-15).

dropped_frames.description: Frames dropped for this connection since it opened.

degraded.description: What is degraded right now, as snake_case slugs; empty when nothing is.

sources.description: One `source/status/v1` body per source the connection's data comes from.

datasets.description: CISP extra: per CIS dataset, its current version and age.

projection_age_s.description: Authority extra: age of the registry projection.

cis_version.description: CISP extra: the CIS version being served.

cis_age_s.description: Any CIS consumer: age of its CIS cache (05: new U-space authorisations refused after 300 s).

nats.description: Bus state as a snake_case slug; the owning system defines the values.

resync_since.description: CISP resync: re-fetch everything changed since this instant (decision record M29).

dp_state.description: Authority extra: F3411 Display Provider state as a snake_case slug; the authority defines the values.
